title: A whole meaning grows between you
meaning: A concrete example can bring your shared view into a whole picture while allowing each person freely to recognise a meaning of their own within it.
text: Understanding a whole can be especially satisfying when each person’s voice is present within it. The Empress in the physical position of Ajna suggests creating examples that let you examine a thought in action. The World in energy supports the wish to connect different parts of experience and see how they work together. The Lovers in emotions respond with the closeness of mutual choice. The understanding may appeal because it genuinely expresses both perspectives. Beyond an accurate explanation, you want to recognise each other’s living involvement in it.

For example, you invent a short dialogue in a language you are learning together. Separate words connect within a scene, and phrases gain a clear purpose. **A shared meaning feels close when both people have a place within it.** You can hear what each person wanted to say and see how particular expressions relate to the whole conversation. The learning example becomes more than a set of correct answers. You enjoy a story understood and chosen together, with personal voices and interest in how the other person’s thought sounds.

The difficulty is treating pleasure in the shared picture as a need to feel identically about all its parts. A small difference begins to seem like lost unity. Your wish to see the whole stays useful when different emphases remain possible. Mutual choice can concern the overall meaning while leaving each person their own words and personal route towards shared understanding.
